errors.trigger: App stage name missing or invalid
errors.diagnosis: The requested stage name does not match any stage defined in the run object
errors.rescue_action: List valid stages and ask the operator to pick one
errors.user_message: Stage not found. Valid stages: {stages}. Pick one.

errors.trigger: Frame, blueprint, run object, stubs, or contracts are missing
errors.diagnosis: The stage cannot be implemented until scaffolding exists
errors.rescue_action: Halt and suggest running /fab-scaffold or repairing the missing artifact
errors.user_message: Forge prerequisites are missing. Run /fab-scaffold or restore the missing files first.

errors.trigger: Stubs do not match blueprint or stage is not ready
errors.diagnosis: The generated stubs do not align with blueprint contracts or the stage status is not active/pending
errors.rescue_action: Regenerate stubs from the blueprint or choose a ready stage
errors.user_message: Stubs are out of sync or the stage is not ready. Repair frame output before forging.

errors.trigger: Tests fail after 3 implementation attempts or approved command fails
errors.diagnosis: The implementation cannot be verified locally after bounded retries
errors.rescue_action: Set status = failed, set last_error, and suggest /fab-fix
errors.user_message: Tests failed after 3 attempts. Run /fab-fix for diagnosis.

errors.trigger: Candidate run object fails schema validation
errors.diagnosis: Verification or stage update would corrupt run state
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and do not replace fabrica.run.json
errors.user_message: The candidate run state failed validation. No state was written.
